creator: Alexander Terp
description: A split onto another machine that has no part of the tab yet joins the tab as a new region at its right-hand end, and the side asked for is ignored (docs/cli/limits.md), because a tab lays machines side by side and keeps no split tree across them. Moving the region afterwards takes a drag. Let the split's side choose where the region goes: left of, or right of, the region holding the pane that was split. Raised while building the right-click Split on Machine item, 2026-10-03.
title: ↔️ A machine joining a tab can be placed left or right of another
